hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: unpaged plugin: the plan was just approved. If a visual-plan board was created for this plan earlier in this session, update its status stamp now using the unpaged MCP tools: on the board's root node, find the text element whose content starts with **Status:** and set its text to '**Status:** 🚀 EXECUTING'. Make no other change to the board now. Then, for as long as you implement this plan, keep the board's Decision log: whenever you deviate from the plan, drop or add a task, or make a choice a reviewer would later ask "why" about, append ONE row to the table on the board's '📝 Decision log' node with table_append_row at the moment you make the choice — cells, left to right: when (date and time), the decision, why, the alternative you rejected, the plan item it touches (phase and task, or 'added'). One line per cell. Never rewrite or delete earlier rows; when the table holds 20 rows, create a second table titled 'Decision log (2)' beneath it on the same node and continue there. If the board has no Decision log node (rendered by an older plugin), skip the logging. If no visual-plan board exists in this session, ignore this message entirely and do not mention it.
